records.title: Address offset vs. reference number
records.problem: Users and tools can mix zero-based protocol offsets with one-based or 3xxxx/4xxxx reference notation.
records.evidence: The Modbus application protocol defines PDU starting addresses from zero. A Pymodbus issue also shows a user explicitly mapping 30001 to address 0.

records.title: Register area defines address identity
records.problem: The same numeric offset can exist in coils, discrete inputs, input registers, and holding registers.
records.evidence: A Pymodbus simulator discussion documents user confusion when holding and input register blocks appear to share numeric positions.

records.title: Word and byte order
records.problem: Values wider than 16 bits can require different word and byte layouts.
records.evidence: A FluentModbus issue records a request for big-endian, little-endian, and byte-swapped variants. The Witte Modbus Poll manual also documents arbitrary word and byte order for wider types.

records.title: Bit order is not byte order
records.problem: Coil and packed-bit order can be confused with multi-register byte order.
records.evidence: A Pymodbus issue reports reversed bit interpretation while explicitly distinguishing it from byte and word endian concerns.

records.title: Serial requests need one queue
records.problem: Several independent polls on one serial route can contend and fail when requests are not queued.
records.evidence: A node-red-contrib-modbus issue reports failures with multiple RTU unit identifiers on one serial port and requests per-route queuing.

records.title: Configured and observed poll rates can differ
records.problem: A configured polling interval can differ from observed request frequency.
records.evidence: A Home Assistant issue reports Modbus sensors polling more often than the configured scan interval.

records.title: Unit identifier 0 is ambiguous
records.problem: Unit identifier zero has transport and tool-specific behavior and can represent broadcast behavior in serial contexts.
records.evidence: A node-red-contrib-modbus issue records inconsistent Unit ID 0 validation. Tool documentation also exposes Unit ID 0 behavior, so generated read workflows must not silently choose it.

records.title: Invalid read block boundaries
records.problem: A read block can become invalid when its start and quantity cross the server's defined data range.
records.evidence: The official protocol defines exception 02 for an invalid address and transfer-length combination. A Pymodbus discussion shows users working to restrict undefined register ranges.

records.title: Malformed or short responses
records.problem: A device can return a byte count or frame length that does not match the received payload.
records.evidence: A Pymodbus issue documents a response whose declared length and received bytes disagree.

records.title: Reusable Modpoll configuration
records.problem: Site work benefits from a reusable configuration that defines poll blocks and named references.
records.evidence: The gavinying/modpoll project documents device, poll, and ref CSV records and describes configuration reuse for device polling.

records.title: Repeatable ModScan tests
records.problem: Production and commissioning tests need repeatable request and expected-response sequences.
records.evidence: WinTECH documents ModScan test scripts as editable message sequences that can run in a loop and log results.

records.title: Versioned Modbus Poll projects
records.problem: A reusable Modbus Poll setup needs a documented and versioned file contract.
records.evidence: Witte documents OLE automation and publishes a Modbus Poll version 12 human-readable XML example.
